The software

The custom Orchard licence covers the implementation, tests, tools, computed fixture reports and implementation documentation in version 0.7.0. The downloadable Python scripts carry the full licence as comments, so the conditions travel with each file.

This is source-available research software. It has commercial restrictions and is not offered as unrestricted open-source software. Earlier private archives retain their own notices.

The publications and brand

The source books and papers retain their stated CC-BY-NC-ND 4.0 terms. The software grant does not relicense them, restrict their existing permissions, or extend to the original logo.

Private manuscript reading copies are omitted from this public edition. Publication access follows the author’s stated release schedule. The Orchard logo identifies this laboratory; no permission to reuse it as your own branding is granted.

A larger Orchard beyond the demonstration

A small visible slice.
A conversation worth beginning.

This laboratory shows selected mechanisms from a much larger body of developed and ongoing work. Most of that wider framework remains undisclosed; its unseen parts do not add evidence to the finite results presented here.

Research collaborations, independent replication and commercial licensing enquiries are welcome. Tell Kimberley about the question, proposed application and setting you have in mind.

kimberlasher@gmail.com ↗

No enquiry is submitted automatically. Any commercial grant or access to undisclosed material requires a separate agreement.
